# DataGrail Careers

Join us and shape the new standard for data privacy professionals.

[Join the team](https://www.datagrail.io/careers/#openings)

## We live by our values

We lead with trust — on our team and with our customers.

![rocket icon](https://www.datagrail.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/DG_ICON_Bias_For_Action.png)

### Bias for Action

Move forward, even in the face of uncertainty. At DataGrail, we believe “this is your company,” so it’s easy to lean into hard problems and fail forward.

![icon smiley](https://www.datagrail.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/DG_ICON_Be_Human.png)

### Be Human

Bring your authentic self to work. It’s important that we create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce to build respect, psychological safety, and collaboration.

![icon customer love](https://www.datagrail.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/DG_ICON_Love_Our_Customers.png)

### Love Our Customers

Always put the customer first. All teams at DataGrail are customer-facing, so we can anticipate our customers’ needs and go the extra mile on their behalf.

![icon trophy](https://www.datagrail.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/DG_ICON_Win_As_A_Team.png)

### Win as a Team

The best results come from working together. We work cross-functionally to make better decisions, avoid assumptions, and solve hard problems.

Good company culture starts at the top, and all three of the leaders show compassion, caring and dedication. There are never any questions if you're sick or if your kid's sick, it's always family first.

[See DataGrail Reviews](https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/DataGrail-Reviews-E2213666.htm?t.s=w-l&apiUserIpAddress=73.92.72.252&t.a=c)

Ensuring the safety of our candidates is of utmost importance to us. Beware of cybercriminals, fake domains, and fraudulent job offers when job hunting. DataGrail employees will only contact applicants from our official company e-mail domain, datagrail.io. In addition, Datagrail recruiters will never ask you to disclose personal financial information or personal IDs. If you receive suspicious communication regarding a job offer or an open position, please contact DataGrail at [security@datagrail.io](mailto:security@datagrail.io) to verify its validity.

## Benefits of working at DataGrail

Healthcare Coverage

We provide a selection of healthcare plans so you and your family feel great.

Time Off

Flexible time off to rest and recharge, generous holiday schedule and a one week winter break at the end of the year.

Career Development

Growth & development opportunities, conferences, and workshops.

Work from Anywhere

Every employee has the choice to select their ideal work environment.

Remote Office Stipend

Monthly reimbursement for home office expenses (ex. Office furniture, work-related hardware, internet, cell phone, co-working space.)
